Context:
- ARR profile: $3.2M annual run-rate at suggested list; with 30% concession and frontloaded credits, net year-1 revenue drops ~45%.

Team — I ran the numbers. See attached workbook for line-item impact. Short summary:
- Scenario A (Connor rec): 28% term discount + 40% Y1 credit amortized over 18 months -> Year-1 recognized rev falls ~47% vs list, cash collected up front improves because prepay is higher, but we carry larger deferred revenue balance. NPV at a 10% discount rate is down ~16% vs list.
- Scenario B (hold): 22% discount + 20% Y1 credit -> Recognized revenue down ~26% Y1; NPV down ~9% vs list.

Recommendation: Approve Scenario A conditional on:
1) Deferred credit amortization schedule (18 months)
2) Contractual usage milestones tied to 50% of year-1 capacity by end of Q2 and 90% by end of Q4 or credits begin to lapse
3) Legal inserts: non-precedent clause + term-limited offer

Attachment: financial_impact_novacare.xlsx (XLSX)
